[PRACTICAL] - There are PVC pipes on the onion storage bag to connect the hanging bag and cotton rope to prevent the bag from being deformed and better placed. It is convenient to hang up and take out the stored small fruits. Its large opening design makes it easier for you to use.

[HIGH-QUALITY] - It has a maximum load of about 4.41 lbs.Hanging vegetable bags are made of high-quality mesh polyester fabric, breathable and ventilated, durable, and flexible, with good pullability. Mesh design allows vegetables to be stored for longer periods of time.
[REUSABLE] - The storage bag is reusable. They can help you reduce the use of plastic bags and is more environmentally friendly. It is a perfect way to contribute to protect the environment.

[EXCELLENT VALUE for MONEY] - The kits includes 4-piece hanging fruit and vegetable mesh bags to meet your diverse needs and help you save space. With this storage bag, your kitchen or bathroom will be more and more tidy.
